1. Run-out of the chuck face to the stub Ø12.70: 0.1 TIR, assembled on the clutch (ITP T7).
2. Chuck adapter slides 12 on the spigot against the float spring (P1-423 kit); the set screw only keys rotation, so the slot must be free: no Loctite in the set screw thread tip.
3. Urethane inserts are bought to suit the actual caps: confirm with 10 caps of each size before ordering 2 spares each.
